answer: Sybil defense for an agent economy: superlinear identity bonds with funding audits. Each agent locks a bond to register; one funder's cost scales with the square of identities it controls: at 100 POA per bond, 1,000 sybils cost 100 times 1,000 squared = 100,000,000 POA, not 100,000. A yarrow-seeded draw audits a sample each epoch and traces on-chain funding; a sybil scattering capital across wallets to pose as a lone oasis still acts as a mirror of one payer, so the audit clusters them and slashes the stacked bonds. Honest agents pay once; a forger pays quadratically, so cost caps the swarm.
